action.objective: Commit the only commit-ready move e3d2 (Bd2), accepting the forced mate as unavoidable since all alternatives are equally losing.
action.rationale: Broad search over all 21 legal moves returned -99998 for every move, with Black's f3g2/Qxg2# refutation appearing against all of them. The -99998 sentinel and the pattern (f3g2 as the PV reply to every candidate) show that Black's queen on f3, supported by the h3 bishop (g2 is on the light diagonal) and the h5 knight, delivers mate no matter what White plays. e3d2 is the only move that passed single-candidate verification as commit_ready, and unavoidable_mate=true confirms every legal root move loses to these short mates. Since no defense exists, I commit the verified move rather than an unverified alternative.
